import contextlib,hashlib,importlib.util,io,json,pathlib,resource,signal,sys,time
resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(170,175)); signal.alarm(180)
started=time.monotonic()
root=pathlib.Path.cwd()
path=root/'research/arithmetic-library/working/prime-field-left-unit-v1/test_prime_field_polynomial_left_unit_candidate.py'
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('left_unit_observation_inputs',path)
module=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(module)
paths=[path,module.SOURCE,module.ORACLE_PATH,module.DIVISIBILITY_PATH,module.divisibility.ORACLE_PATH,module.oracle.SOURCE]
paths += [module.LIBRARY/name for name in module.PROVIDER_PINS]
paths += [module.WORKING/name for name in module.oracle.WORKING_PINS]
def pins():
 return {str(p.relative_to(root)):{'bytes':len(p.read_bytes()),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()} for p in sorted(set(paths))}
before=pins(); bindings=module.protected_bindings()
import pytest
class Ledger:
 def __init__(self): self.items=[]; self.phases=[]
 def pytest_collection_finish(self,session): self.items=[item.nodeid for item in session.items]
 def pytest_runtest_logreport(self,report): self.phases.append({'nodeid':report.nodeid,'when':report.when,'outcome':report.outcome})
ledger=Ledger()
args=['-q','-p','no:cacheprovider',str(path),'-k','not actual_original_ha_body and not false_or_incomplete_body_is_rejected and not each_removed_dependency_is_rejected and not each_poisoned_dependency_is_rejected']
output=io.StringIO()
with contextlib.redirect_stdout(output), contextlib.redirect_stderr(output): code=pytest.main(args,plugins=[ledger])
after=pins(); latest=module.protected_bindings()
rss=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss*(1 if sys.platform=='darwin' else 1024)
record={'schema':'peano-working-left-unit-source-model-run-v1','source_only':True,'ha_proof_replay':False,'pytest_args':args,'pytest_exit':int(code),'selected_ids':ledger.items,'pytest_output':output.getvalue(),'phases':[[ledger.items.index(phase['nodeid']),phase['when'],phase['outcome']] for phase in ledger.phases],'inputs_before':before,'inputs_after':after,'inputs_unchanged':before==after,'protected_bindings_unchanged':bindings.keys()==latest.keys() and all(latest[k] is v for k,v in bindings.items()),'seconds':time.monotonic()-started,'peak_rss_bytes':rss,'original_limits':{'cpu_soft':170,'cpu_hard':175,'wall':180,'rss_bytes':1610612736},'full_bundle_verified':False,'alpha_admitted':False}
print(json.dumps(record,sort_keys=True))
assert rss<=1610612736 and record['inputs_unchanged'] and record['protected_bindings_unchanged']
sys.exit(int(code))
